children: Tesla (TSLA) launched the Cybercab in Austin and said its unsupervised robotaxi fleet exceeded 1 million miles, up from 380,000 miles six weeks earlier; shares later recovered.
Tesla (TSLA) registered 646 vehicles in India April–Sept 2026, up from 69 a year earlier. Luxury EV market share rose to 14.6% from 2.5%. September registrations: 296 units.
Tesla (TSLA) confirmed Roadster production in 2028 with three trims: Base Performance (reservation $50,000), Thrust ($250,000 with rockets) and invite-only Rocket with full flying system.
Tesla (TSLA) launches Model Y in India: five-seat from ₹50.89 lakh, six-seat L from ₹61.99 lakh. Acceleration Boost ~0–100 km/h in 4.5s. WLTP range up to 681 km. 20 Supercharger stalls live.
Tesla (TSLA) released Oct 15 video showing redesigned Roadster tested at a SpaceX Texas site: vehicle launched off a ramp with cold‑gas thrusters, rotated midair and landed.
Elon Musk said Tesla’s value will hinge on Optimus humanoid robots and Cybercab autonomous taxis, noting added potential in AI, robotics, solar and large-scale space transport.
Tesla CEO Elon Musk said he spent about four months at the White House, longer than planned, and admitted this diverted time from Tesla priorities, delaying focus on AI.
